team.readOnly: Only Admins change this task: {{admins}}. You read it, run it and claim it.
team.readOnlyUnnamed: Only Admins change this task. You read it, run it and claim it.

lifecycle.doneDetail: Marking it done ended its claim.
lifecycle.blockedHolder: Nothing runs while it is blocked. Clear it when work can go on; your claim stays.
lifecycle.blockedAdmin: As an Admin you can clear it for {{holder}} or close the task; closing ends the claim.
lifecycle.blockedFree: Nothing runs while it is blocked. Clear it when work can go on.
lifecycle.blockedPlain: Nothing runs while it is blocked.
lifecycle.lockHolder: Only Admins cancel or reopen a team task: {{admins}}.
lifecycle.lockHolderUnnamed: Only Admins cancel or reopen a team task.
lifecycle.lockOpen: Only {{holder}} (the claim) and Admins close this task: {{admins}}.
lifecycle.lockOpenUnnamed: Only {{holder}} (the claim) and Admins close this task.
lifecycle.lockOpenFree: Only the person who claims it and Admins close this task: {{admins}}.
lifecycle.lockOpenFreeUnnamed: Only the person who claims it and Admins close this task.

lifecycle.lockClosedUnnamed: Only Admins reopen a team task.

reopen.label: Reopen
reopen.free: A reopened task is free: nobody holds it, and nothing runs until someone claims it.

block.label: Mark as blocked
block.title: Mark {{task}} as blocked
block.explain: Say what it waits for. Everyone on the team reads it on the task until you or an Admin clears it. Nothing runs while it is blocked, and your claim stays.
block.hint: Required. It shows on the task's rail and in the Tasks list.
block.unavailable: Unavailable: say what it waits for.

run.holder: Its steps and conversation stay on {{holder}}'s computer; the team server only knows the run is {{state}} · last report {{time}}.
run.yourOther: Its steps and conversation stay on your other computer; this computer sees what the team server reports · {{state}} · last report {{time}}.
run.stale: The team server last heard from {{holder}}'s run at {{time}} · paused or closed there. Its steps stay on their computer.
run.holderNotStarted: No run yet. {{holder}} holds the claim, so the run starts on their computer.
run.yourOtherNotStarted: No run yet. Your other computer holds the claim, so the run starts there.
run.underModule: No run yet. {{holder}} starts it under their module claim; its runs merge into {{branch}}.
run.underModuleNoBranch: No run yet. {{holder}} starts it under their module claim.

stopped.none: Run {{run}} stopped in {{step}}. It reports nothing more to the team server ({{why}}); it stays here to read.
stopped.one: Run {{run}} stopped in {{step}}. The team server refused its unsent report ({{why}}); it stays here to read, not sent again.
stopped.other: Run {{run}} stopped in {{step}}. The team server refused its {{count}} unsent reports ({{why}}); they stay here to read, not sent again.

why.superseded: a newer run carries the work on

claim.hereTitle: Claimed by you on this computer
claim.hereDetail: {{computer}} holds the claim and the running step renews it · renewed {{time}} · stale after {{minutes}} min without renewal.
claim.detail: Renewed {{time}} · stale after {{minutes}} min without renewal.
claim.waitingTitle: Your claim isn't renewed while the run waits for you
claim.waitingDetail: Only Running work renews a claim; the team server refuses renewal while a run waits for you. Last renewed {{time}} · stale at {{staleAt}}, in {{left}} min · then anyone may take {{task}} over.
claim.reviewTitle: Your claim isn't renewed while the run is in review
claim.reviewDetail: A run in review doesn't renew it either · stale at {{staleAt}}, in {{left}} min.
claim.yoursStaleDetail: Nobody has taken {{task}} over yet. Continue renews the claim and resumes your saved run.
claim.nobodyDetail: Claim it to run it on this computer; the run follows {{pipeline}}.
claim.nobodyDetailNoPipeline: Claim it to run it on this computer.
claim.otherDetail: Their running step renews it · renewed {{time}}. You can take the task over only once the claim is stale ({{minutes}} min without renewal).
claim.otherAdminDetail: {{holder}} claimed it at {{time}}. As an Admin you can close it for them; either way their claim ends.
claim.elsewhereTitle: Claimed by you on another computer
claim.elsewhereDetail: The claim belongs to that computer, not to your account: this one can't run, pause or report for the task while it holds. Release it there to work here.
claim.moduleDetail: Picking up a module claims all of its tasks. While {{holder}}'s module claim holds, nobody claims {{task}} on its own, even when the task itself is idle.
claim.staleDetail: No renewal for {{age}} min; the team server's stale threshold is {{minutes}} min. Until someone takes it over, {{holder}} can still renew it and continue their saved work.
claim.takenOverDetail: Your claim had gone stale. Orchester stopped run {{run}} here; its worktree stays on this computer as detached work. It can't report or deliver for {{task}} any more, and {{holder}} starts again from the pipeline.
claim.unassignedDetail: An Admin's unassignment ends the claim at once. Run {{run}} stopped; its worktree stays here as detached work.
claim.removedTitle: You're no longer a member of {{team}}
claim.removedDetail: Run {{run}} stopped; its worktree and conversation stay on this computer.
claim.movedDetail: You took the task on your other computer, so the claim moved there. Run {{run}} here stopped; its worktree stays on this computer as detached work and can't report for {{task}} any more.

takeOver.title: Take over {{task}} from {{holder}}?
takeOver.claim: The team server gives the claim to you on {{computer}}, and {{holder}}'s claim stops counting: their run can't report or deliver any more.
takeOver.fresh: A new run starts from {{pipeline}}, the Admin's pipeline. Nothing of {{holder}}'s run comes along; their worktree stays on their computer.

refused.dismissTitle: Couldn't dismiss the notice about {{task}}'s run
refused.renewed: {{holder}} renewed the claim at {{time}}, before your request reached the team server. The task stays with them; nothing started on this computer.
refused.conflict: Someone else holds the claim now.
refused.moduleConflict: Its module's claim covers it: only the module's holder claims it.
refused.lost: The claim isn't this computer's any more.
refused.busy: An agent of its run is at work; pause or stop the run first.
refused.denied: The team server doesn't allow it while the task stands as it does now.
refused.decision: The team server waits for a decision before it allows this.
refused.removed: You're no longer a member of the team.
refused.changed: The task changed on the team server meanwhile; nothing was changed.
refused.unavailable: The team server can't be reached now; nothing was changed. Try again.
refused.needsVersion: The team server needs Orchester {{version}}; nothing was changed. Update Orchester, then try again.
refused.signedOut: This computer isn't signed in to the team server.
refused.failed: It could not be carried out on this computer.
refused.waiting: The run waits for the team server or the runner, and starts once they answer.
refused.startUnreadable: This start's record can't be read here — for example it was written by a newer Orchester — so it isn't carried on. Update Orchester on this computer, or run the task again.
refused.notReady: The task names no module, or a pipeline this computer doesn't have.
refused.branch: The module's branch {{branch}} isn't in this checkout.
refused.notReadable: The team server's pipeline or one of its agent profiles can't be read.
refused.bundleSchemaNewer: The team server built this run in bundle schema {{built}}, and this app reads schema {{read}}. Update Orchester on this computer, then run it again. Nothing ran.
refused.bundleSchemaOlder: The team server built this run in bundle schema {{built}}, and this app reads schema {{read}}. The team server is older than this app: ask whoever runs it to update it. Nothing ran.
refused.bundleUnreadable: The team server answered this run's bundle with something this app can't read. If Orchester and the team server are on different releases, update them. Nothing ran.
refused.bundleMismatch: The bundle the team server answered isn't the one it announced for this run, so it wasn't used. Nothing ran. Run it again; if it happens again, tell a team Admin.
refused.inputsFailed: This computer couldn't make the run's inputs from the bundle the team server built, so nothing ran. Check the agent profiles' connections in Agents, then run it again.
refused.claimReleased: Your claim on the task was released.
refused.claimKept: Your claim on the task is kept, because another run here still needs it.
refused.claimHeld: The team server refused to release your claim on the task, so it may still be held.
refused.notHolder: Only the person who holds this task's claim, or an Admin, does this. The claim may have changed; the page shows it as it is now.
refused.stopRunFirst: A run of this task is still working or waits for you. Stop it first, then mark the task done or cancel it.
refused.missingReason: A blocked reason can't be empty.

archived.title: Stopped: {{resource}} was archived
archived.body: {{who}} archived the team {{kind}} {{resource}} at {{time}}. Run {{run}} used it, so it was stopped; the worktree, changes and conversation are kept.
archived.bodyUnnamed: The team {{kind}} {{resource}} was archived at {{time}}. Run {{run}} used it, so it was stopped; the worktree, changes and conversation are kept.
archived.bodyLegacy: {{resource}} was archived at {{time}}. Run {{run}} used it, so it was stopped; the worktree, changes and conversation are kept.
archived.event: {{step}} stopped: the team archived {{resource}}, which this run pinned.
archived.eventNoStep: The run stopped: the team archived {{resource}}, which it pinned.
archived.stillUses: still uses {{resource}} · not ready anywhere until changed

notReady.title: Not ready · nothing started
notReady.titleTeam: Not ready on this computer · nothing started
notReady.titleAfterStart: Not ready on this computer · nothing ran
notReady.body: Fix these and press Run again. Nothing is queued until then.
notReady.bodyTeam: Fix these on this computer and press Run again. They stay here; the team's server and other computers are not changed.
notReady.bodyAfterStart: The team server made the work for this start, but nothing ran, so your claim on the task was released. Fix these on this computer and press Run again; it claims the task again. They stay here; other computers are not changed.
notReady.bodyAfterStartKept: The team server made the work for this start, but nothing ran. Your claim on the task is kept, because another run here still needs it. Fix these on this computer and press Run again. They stay here; other computers are not changed.
notReady.bodyAfterStartHeld: The team server made the work for this start, but nothing ran, and it refused to release your claim on the task, so it may still be held. Fix these on this computer and press Run again. They stay here; other computers are not changed.
notReady.footnote: Each fix opens its field in Agents
notReady.footnoteTeam: Runs start from the cached team versions, also offline

notice.bodyTeam: {{pipeline}} is not ready on this computer, so nothing was started. The Summary lists what is missing and how to fix it.

base.detached: no branch was checked out when run #{{run}} started
base.project: the project's base branch when run #{{run}} started
base.nextStarts: the next run starts from it
base.nextTakesCheckedOut: the next run takes the branch checked out when it starts
base.keptTask: run #{{run}} keeps it · the task now says {{branch}}; the next run starts from {{branch}}
base.keptModule: run #{{run}} keeps it · its module now says {{branch}}; the next run starts from {{branch}}
base.keptCheckedOut: run #{{run}} keeps it · the next run takes the branch checked out when it starts
base.noBranchWhy: the checkout is on no branch (detached at {{head}}). Set a base branch for the task or its module, or check out a branch

properties.pipelineGone: {{version}} of a pipeline no longer in the project
properties.taskNow: The latest run started with this; the task has {{value}} now.

facts.more: Account, cached input, duration, agents, approvals, permissions

notice.draftBody: Add what the task still needs in Edit, then run it.
notice.queuedTitle: Queued · its run has not started
notice.queuedBody: Start run asks the runner to start it; the task never gets a second run.
notice.elsewhereBody: Its steps, results and changes are on that computer, not this one. Here you see only what its holder reports.
notice.pendingTitle: Queued · waiting for its run to start
notice.pendingBody: The runner starts it once an agent is free.
notice.runningBody: {{agent}} works in the run's own worktree on {{branch}}; your checkout is not touched.

slotWaitBody.one: {{steps}} is ready and starts when an agent slot frees up; every slot is in use. Raising Agents at once in Project settings › Runs › Limits starts it sooner.
slotWaitBody.other: {{steps}} are ready and start when an agent slot frees up; every slot is in use. Raising Agents at once in Project settings › Runs › Limits starts them sooner.

notice.returnedResolvingTitle: Returned to {{step}} to resolve the conflicts with {{branch}}
notice.returnedResolvingBody: {{agent}} merges {{branch}} into the run's branch in its worktree and resolves {{files}}. The steps after {{step}} run again; nothing reaches {{branch}} until you merge.
notice.pausingBody: {{agent}} finishes what it is doing at {{step}}; the run then pauses with its work saved on {{branch}}.
notice.pausingBodyCommand: {{step}} runs {{tool}}; the run pauses once the command ends, with its work saved on {{branch}}.
notice.pausingBodyCommandUnnamed: {{step}} runs a command; the run pauses once the command ends, with its work saved on {{branch}}.
notice.pausingBodySteps: {{steps}} are still at work; the run pauses once they end, with its work saved on {{branch}}.
notice.askingBody: {{step}} waits for your answer in the conversation.
notice.planTitle: Your approval is needed · plan v{{version}}
notice.planBody: {{agent}} wrote a plan. Approving it lets the run go on; nothing runs until you decide.
notice.approvalBody: {{step}} waits since {{time}} for a request its profile does not allow. Answer it in the conversation.
notice.pausedBody: Resume run continues {{step}} in the same worktree.
notice.stoppedKept: Work up to {{checkpoint}} is kept on {{branch}}.
notice.stoppedUnsaved: Its work since the last checkpoint stays in the worktree.
notice.tokenLimitBody: {{step}} stopped after the run used its whole {{budget}}-token budget. {{kept}}
notice.timeLimitBody: {{step}} stopped when the run's active agent time reached its limit. {{kept}}
notice.stepBudgetTitle: Stopped at the step budget of {{step}}
notice.groupBudgetBody: The tasks run together used their shared budget. {{kept}}
notice.dailyBudgetTitle: Stopped at the daily token budget
notice.dailyBudgetBody: {{agent}} stopped when the project's budget for today was used. {{kept}} Resume run continues it once the day has room again.
notice.interruptedBody: The run stopped without settling; its last checkpoint {{checkpoint}} is kept. Continue run takes it up from there.
notice.interruptedNoCheckpointBody: The run stopped before its first checkpoint. Continue run takes it up from its start.
notice.storageContentionBody: The project database stayed busy with other work, so the runner stopped the run; its last checkpoint {{checkpoint}} is kept. Continue run takes it up from there.
notice.storageContentionNoCheckpointBody: The project database stayed busy with other work, so the runner stopped the run before its first checkpoint. Continue run takes it up from its start.
notice.storageFailureBody: The runner could not use the project database (damaged, full, read-only or out of reach), so it stopped the run; its last checkpoint {{checkpoint}} is kept. Once the database is fixed, Continue run takes it up from there.
notice.storageFailureNoCheckpointBody: The runner could not use the project database (damaged, full, read-only or out of reach), so it stopped the run before its first checkpoint. Once the database is fixed, Continue run takes it up from its start.
notice.runnerErrorBody: The runner hit an error of its own and stopped the run; its last checkpoint {{checkpoint}} is kept. The conversation shows the error; Continue run takes it up from there.
notice.runnerErrorNoCheckpointBody: The runner hit an error of its own and stopped the run before its first checkpoint. The conversation shows the error; Continue run takes it up from its start.
notice.cantContinueBody: Its worktree was removed at {{time}}; work up to its last checkpoint stays on {{branch}}. Run again starts a new run.
notice.cantContinueNotRemovedBody: Its worktree could not be removed: {{path}} stays ({{reason}}). Work up to its last checkpoint stays on {{branch}}. Remove worktree tries again; Run again starts a new run.
notice.cantContinueNotRemovedNoReasonBody: Its worktree could not be removed: {{path}} is still on disk. Work up to its last checkpoint stays on {{branch}}. Remove worktree tries again; Run again starts a new run.
notice.lostReconnecting: The runner dropped and is reconnecting; the run continues once it is back.
notice.lostOffline: The runner could not be restarted; its agent is gone. Restart the runner, then continue the run.
notice.lostNotConnected: No runner is connected; the run continues once one is.
notice.succeededBody: Every step of the run passed. Its changes on {{branch}} wait for your review.
notice.mergedBody: The run's work on {{branch}} was merged.
notice.mergedOutsideBody: The run's work on {{branch}} is in {{into}}: it was merged without Orchester.
notice.nothingToMergeBody: Every step of the run passed. Its result is its report: it committed nothing on {{branch}}, so there is nothing to merge.
notice.completedBody: Every step of the run passed and its report is kept as the run's Report. It committed nothing on {{branch}}.
notice.committedNothingTitle: This run committed nothing, but its pipeline expects changes
notice.committedNothingBody: Every step passed, yet nothing was committed on {{branch}}. Complete the task anyway, return the work to a step with a note, or run the task again.
notice.unchangedTitle: {{step}} was not run again: nothing changed
notice.stuckBody: The run waits for your decision; nothing runs until you choose.
notice.failedBody: {{agent}} could not finish the step. The conversation has its account.
notice.failedCommandBody: Its command failed. The conversation has its output.
notice.cancelledBody: Nothing runs any more; its committed work stays on {{branch}}.
notice.notStartedBody: Its worktree could not be created, so no step ran. Fix the cause, then run the task again. Reason: {{reason}}
notice.readyBody: Run queues it and starts its first run.
notice.tokenLimitCheckpointTitle: Stopped at the token limit · checkpoint {{checkpoint}}
notice.planBodyNext: {{agent}} wrote a plan. Approving it starts {{next}} with {{nextAgent}}; nothing runs until you decide.
notice.planLimitBody: The CLI refused {{step}}'s next turn: its account reached its plan limit. {{agent}}'s session is kept in the account's folder. {{kept}}

menu.label: Run actions

worktree.unreadable: Nothing can be said of its worktree while run #{{run}} can't be read
worktree.unreadableUnnumbered: Nothing can be said of its worktree while the run can't be read
worktree.none: No worktree: the run never started
worktree.inUse: Worktree in use · Remove worktree comes back when the run ends · {{branch}}

remove.explanationOther: Removes the worktrees of run #{{run}}, build output included. Committed work stays on their branches; a branch whose commits are merged is deleted.
remove.interrupted: Run #{{run}} was interrupted: without its worktree it can never continue.
remove.discard: Discard the uncommitted changes listed above
remove.otherWorking: Run #{{run}} keeps working; its worktree is not touched.

runs.lost: No runner is connected; the run continues once one is.

thisRun.worktreeNotRemovedNoReason: Not removed · {{path}} is still on disk

report.none: No step of the run reported anything.
